summary: Completed comprehensive authentication and UI testing for MagWatchWeb streaming platform. All core authentication features working correctly including registration, login, profile management, and UI improvements with rounded-full buttons, gradients, and hover effects. Backend APIs fully functional.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile menu links not visible when menu is opened on mobile viewport

passed_tests: Backend API root endpoint accessible
User registration with JWT token generation
Duplicate email registration properly rejected
User profile retrieval with JWT authentication
Login with valid credentials
Login with invalid credentials properly rejected
Profile access without token returns 401/403
Profile access with invalid token returns 401
History endpoints (add/get) working correctly
AuthModal opens and closes correctly
AuthModal toggle between login/register modes
Registration form validation (password minimum 6 characters)
Complete authentication flow (register → login → profile → logout)
Profile page displays real user data (email, name, created date, ID)
Profile logout functionality and redirection to home
Login button styling with rounded-full, gradient, shadow, hover effects
Navigation links styling with rounded-full and hover effects
Logo hover group effects working
Error toast notifications (Sonner) display correctly
Mobile responsive design and mobile menu toggle
Player page error handling for invalid torrents
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix mobile menu visibility issue - menu links not showing when mobile menu is opened on mobile viewport
